about.reference:
Referrals got you here. They won't get you to next year's number.

You know the pattern. A great month, then a quiet one. A pipeline that depends on who introduced you to whom. A marketing budget that produces leads nobody in sales wants to call.

I've spent 10+ years fixing exactly this, for 400+ brands in 47+ industries across 21+ countries.

Here's what I found: the companies with predictable revenue don't have better luck. They run one measured system:

→ Traffic: calendar invites, cold email and LinkedIn, sent from their own accounts
→ A registration page that feeds one CRM
→ Reminders by email and WhatsApp, so registrants actually show up
→ A live session that ends with the right people asking for a call
→ One pipeline, and one weekly number for every stage

For a UK business-coaching group we built this around a webinar series. Across 11 webinars: 765,105 people reached, 6,517 registered, 80 sales calls booked.

Today I run Tantra. We build that system with B2B teams, and AI now does most of the repetitive work: the invites, the reminders, the follow-ups.

Every Thursday at 11:00 UK time, I take it apart live, stage by stage, in 60 minutes. You'll see how the invites are written, how the reminders are timed, and how 45 minutes turns into booked calls.

Two ways in:
→ Join the live AI RevOps workshop: https://go.usetantra.com/l/adi-aw
→ Book an AI revenue strategy consultation: https://go.usetantra.com/l/adi-ac

The launch went fine. It's week six that breaks.

You've seen it. Week one gets everyone's attention. By week six the reminder didn't go out, the replay link is wrong, and nobody knows who was meant to follow up with the people who asked a question.

Funnels rarely fail because of a bad idea. They fail because nobody owns the boring parts.

I run marketing operations at Tantra. For every stage of a client's funnel I set three things:

→ One owner
→ One checklist
→ One number we check every week

That's how a webinar keeps running instead of happening once. One client ran 11 webinars from May 2025 to February 2026, with a weekly analytics sheet and a 12-item experiment log behind them.

If you run operations, you know the real problem: work that depends on someone remembering.

about.reference:
Someone registers for your webinar on Monday. By Thursday they've forgotten why.

Nobody sent the reminder. Or it went out at 2am their time. Or it landed in an inbox they check once a week.

Most of what happens between "registered" and "booked a call" is repetitive work: reminders, follow-ups, handoffs to sales. None of it should depend on a person remembering.

I build the automation at Tantra. My work sits in those gaps:

→ Reminders by email and WhatsApp, timed to each registrant
→ Follow-ups that change with what each person did: came live, left early, didn't show
→ Handoffs that put a booked call in front of the right closer, with the context attached

Tantra now runs most of this across Gmail, LinkedIn and WhatsApp, from your own accounts.

In one client's best webinar, 1,990 people registered and 321 came live. That gap is where automation earns its keep.

Every Thursday at 11:00 UK time, our founder Adi shows the whole system live in 60 minutes, including exactly which parts AI runs and which still need you.

Most B2B stacks leak at the joins. The lead isn't lost inside a tool. It's lost between two of them, and nobody notices until a sales rep asks why the CRM record is empty.

→ Every form, booking and webinar event posts to one CRM
→ Every link is tagged by source, so you know which channel produced the call
→ AI agents send the invites, reminders and follow-ups from your own Gmail, LinkedIn and WhatsApp

One record per person, from first invite to signed client. That's the whole idea.

overview.reference:
Most B2B companies don't have a lead problem. They have a leak problem. Marketing counts leads, sales counts deals, and nobody owns what happens in between.

Tantra builds the in between: AI revenue systems that take a stranger from first invite to signed client, with one CRM and one weekly number for every stage.

See it working first. Every Thursday at 11:00 UK time, our founder Adi runs a live 60-minute webinar that takes the whole funnel apart:

→ How to fill a session from a cold list with calendar invites, cold email and LinkedIn
→ The email and WhatsApp reminders that get registrants into the room
→ How 45 minutes becomes booked sales calls
→ The weekly rhythm: one pipeline, one analytics sheet, one experiment log
→ Which parts AI runs, and which still need you

Register with the button at the top of this page.

What we build with your team:
→ Traffic: calendar invites, cold email and LinkedIn, sent from your own accounts
→ Capture: registration and booking pages that feed one CRM
→ Nurture: email and WhatsApp reminders and follow-ups
→ Conversion: a weekly live webinar that ends in booked sales calls
→ Pipeline: every booking, call and proposal tracked to the deal

Our team has built funnels and outreach for 400+ brands in 47+ industries across 21+ countries, over 10+ years.

Two ways to work with us:
→ The Tantra platform: run outreach and nurture from your own accounts. Start at usetantra.com
→ Tantra Enterprise: we build your funnel with you, coach your team for 3 months, and you get a year on the platform

Start with the live workshop: https://go.usetantra.com/l/tantra-aw
Or book an AI revenue strategy consultation: https://go.usetantra.com/l/tantra-ac
